// Cobalt Cabinet production art source. Rebuild every output with: sh tools/regenerate.sh  (see STYLE_GUIDE.md, section 14)
// Every sprite is a 16x16 frame; a sprite's frames become one horizontal strip PNG (frame 0 on the left).
// "." is transparent. Keys are the 19 palette slots below (all used); never add a colour without updating STYLE_GUIDE.md.
// Look rules: no ink outlines; every pickup is a solid silhouette of at most 4 colours, like an early-1980s hardware sprite.
// The player and the enemies are rolling balls generated by tools/balls.js (body, band, white shine; see the balls section).
// Light comes from the top-left on walls, pellets and pickups; the balls' shine is top-centre so mirroring never moves it.
//
// Palette table (contrast vs N; the tools need N, J, L/D and W/S in these roles, and K and Y to exist):
//   N  #060a1c  night       1.0:1  background and corridors, camera clear colour
//   J  #173596  cobalt      1.9:1  wall core          S  #4378f0  azure      4.9:1  wall bevel band, pellet glow, HUD digit shadow
//   L  #b8e4ff  ice        14.6:1  wall lit edge, pellet glint, HUD label   D  #2756d8  deep blue  3.2:1  HUD label shadow only
//   E  #0c1a52  navy        1.2:1  wall shade (2px)   W  #ffffff  white     19.7:1  ball shines, player bands, pellet core, HUD digits
//   K  #020410  ink         1.0:1  melon seeds, debug-target rim, vignette tint
//   H  #46d860  green      10.5:1  player ball        F  #0d5e2b  forest     2.5:1  player ball crescent
//   I  #ff5cc8  pink        7.9:1  Chase ball         Z  #a8226e  deep pink  2.7:1  Chase band
//   O  #ff8a1f  orange      8.3:1  CutOff ball, orange rind, caramel, bell and key shading, cork    A  #ffb347  tangerine 11.0:1  orange flesh
//   R  #ff3b3b  red         5.6:1  Scared ball, CutOff and Random bands, red fruit, bell bow    C  #b3122b  crimson  2.8:1  Scared band
//   P  #ffcfc6  light red  14.0:1  Random ball        T  #1fa858  jade       6.4:1  leaves and stems    Y  #ffcf3a  gold  13.3:1  bell, key, seeds

@palette
N #060a1c night: background and corridors (camera clear colour; never drawn inside sprites)
J #173596 cobalt: wall core fill, always flat
S #4378f0 azure: wall bevel band, pellet glow on the shaded side, HUD digit shadow, points popup shadow, burst sparks
L #b8e4ff ice: wall lit edge, pellet glint, HUD label, burst rays and centre, potion brew
D #2756d8 deep blue: HUD label shadow only
E #0c1a52 navy: wall shade (2px) on the south and east faces
W #ffffff white: ball shines, the player's bands, sticks, pickup shines, wall corner glint, pellet core and twinkle, burst core, HUD digits, points popup
K #020410 ink: melon seeds, debug-target rim and vignette tint (never an outline)
Y #ffcf3a gold: bell, key, strawberry seeds, caramel highlight
R #ff3b3b red: Scared ball body, CutOff and Random ball bands; cherry, strawberry, apple, melon flesh, bell bow
C #b3122b crimson: Scared ball band
I #ff5cc8 pink: Chase ball body
Z #a8226e deep pink: Chase ball band
P #ffcfc6 light red: Random ball body
O #ff8a1f orange: CutOff ball body; orange rind, toffee caramel, bell and key shading, potion cork
A #ffb347 tangerine: orange flesh
T #1fa858 jade: pickup stems, leaves and melon rind
H #46d860 green: player ball body
F #0d5e2b forest: player ball shade crescent

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- balls: generated by node tools/balls.js art.txt (edit its BALLS list and re-run, never hand-edit); 4-frame rolling strips for the player and each enemy

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- player: bright green ball, white bands (a pattern no enemy shares, so red-green colour-blind players can still pick it out); rolling right, bands moving right (mirrored in code for left)
